decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The dwelling incorporating the basement, shall not be used                                                                                           any time other than for a single dwelling. The basement shall at no time be used or occupied separately from the existing dwelling (10 Heathfield Gardens, Chiswick, London, W4 4JY).
Condition : 5 - The additional rooms to the basement hereby approved shall only be used for uses incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse and not used s main living rooms or bedrooms.

Condition : 6 - The boundary wall along the Heathfield Gardens frontage shall be rebuilt with brick / metal railing and brick piers at the gates in a style in keeping with the character of the adjoining front walls as per the email submitted 5 February 2007 within 6 months of the commencement of works, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Council.
description: Creation of a basement and a new sunken rear court yard to the existing house.
